vehicle_or_wheel: Scarecrow (Mars weight MSL test rover, 340 kg, 50 cm diameter rigid grousered wheels, 40 cm wide, EGP 5.75 kPa) and DTM (Dynamic Test Model, 437 kg, same wheels)
terrain_description: Constructed test beds in the JPL Marsyard: smooth flagstone simulated bedrock (slopes flat to 30 deg; three DTM and four Scarecrow runs, Sec 6.1) and constructed cohesive soil slopes (four DTM and two Scarecrow runs, Sec 6.2)
soil_parameters_reported: Not reported numerically; cohesive soil described as variable with moisture, compaction and cohesion; cone penetrometer data only in Figure 8
method: Direct upslope drives at top speed (4.2 cm/s), slip vs slope compiled per terrain, slip from Eq. 4
metric: Maximum traversable slope on smooth bedrock; slip on Marsyard cohesive soil at 20 deg
value: Bedrock traversable up to 22 deg (Abstract); Marsyard cohesive soil up to 75% slip at 20 deg with steady uphill progress and no embedding (Sec 6.2)
source_title: Traverse Performance Characterization for the Mars Science Laboratory Rover (Heverly et al. 2013, J. Field Robotics 30(6), 835-846)
passage_or_location: Abstract p. 835; Section 6.1 p. 841 to 842 with Figure 9; Section 6.2 p. 842 with Figure 10

vehicle_or_wheel: Scarecrow (Mars weight MSL test rover, 340 kg, 50 cm diameter rigid grousered wheels, 40 cm wide, EGP 5.75 kPa)
terrain_description: Cohesive soil of the desiccated lake bed at Tecopa CA, natural slopes flat to 28 deg; four Scarecrow runs (Sec 6.2)
soil_parameters_reported: Not reported numerically; described as low enough compaction for the grousers to penetrate and high enough shear strength not to fail (Sec 6.2)
method: Direct upslope drives at top speed (4.2 cm/s), slip from Eq. 4
metric: Slip at the steepest slope climbed
value: less than 50% slip at 28 deg (Sec 6.2, Tecopa); Section 10 states 30% slip at 28 deg in strong cohesive soil without naming the site
source_title: Traverse Performance Characterization for the Mars Science Laboratory Rover (Heverly et al. 2013, J. Field Robotics 30(6), 835-846)
